input.quote: are the property of Company to the extent that such Works were created by Contractor for Company over a time period for which Company has been invoiced and said invoice has been paid
input.rationale: Works vest in us only for invoiced-and-paid periods (acceptable in principle), but the agreement never confirms that we retain ownership of the data, content and materials we supply, while Section 4(b)(ii) sweeps "records relating to the Services" into Contractor's exclusive property. We added a Company Data ownership sentence confirming no transfer of our IP or data to Contractor and no joint ownership.

input.quote: Contractor hereby grants to Company a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense) to use, copy, modify, create, derivative version, publicly perform and publicly display such Contractor's Information in connection with Company's business operations.
input.rationale: The licence to Contractor Information embedded in the Works is perpetual and sublicensable but is not stated to be irrevocable or worldwide, does not name our affiliates or contractors acting on our behalf, and is not transferable to a successor. We made those minimal additions so the Works we pay for can be used across our group.
